name: Eclipse -Zettai Reido Keikaku Soushitsu Shoujo-
original_name: ECLIPSE－絶対隷奴計画・喪失少女－
source:
Somewhere on the Darkside of the Moon, Second Lieutenant Fernandez and his all-female pilot squad are fighting for their lives against overwhelming forces. The XEN-TRIX mobile suit is technologically superior, but even cutting edge technology doesn't count for too much if you are outnumbered twenty to one.
Inevitably, a well placed shot inflicts critical damage, and Fernandez falls into a dark oblivion of wild memories...

[From a [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140908065044/http://www.jastusa.com/forums/viewtopic.php?f=16&t=5389]forum post[/url] by Baldo]
translation:
月球背面的某处，费尔南德斯少尉与一支全部由女性组成的驾驶员小队，正在数量占据绝对优势的敌军面前为生存而战。XEN-TRIX机动战斗服拥有更先进的技术，可在敌我数量达到二十比一时，即便尖端科技也难以发挥多少作用。
果不其然，一发精准攻击造成致命损伤，费尔南德斯坠入由狂乱记忆构成的黑暗深渊…

[摘自Baldo的一篇[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140908065044/http://www.jastusa.com/forums/viewtopic.php?f=16&t=5389]论坛帖子[/url]]
